snippet.title: Skunny - Desert Raid gameplay (PC Game, 1993)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Skunny - Desert Raid, Dos PC game produced by Copysoft in 1993 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/skunny-desert-raid/4611/
Skinny - Rapid Desert is a fun game, fighters, pretty well animated. Fly a plane, you must pass various levels very interesting, you need some skill. Good luck.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
